text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the park, I spotted 
Tokai Teio playing with some children.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Come and catch me if you can, 
everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah... this is so frustrating! If that's 
how it's gonna be――

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Everyone!! Fall in!! Catch Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, even if you gang up on me, it's 
useless, useless! Catching me is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Isn't that a little too much!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... No matter how you look at it, 
having 30 taggers is totally unfair~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, they didn't catch me till the end, 
but... yeah.
Tokai Teio was completely worn out.
